config.notes: HF_TOKEN holds a Hugging Face access token (https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens). It is sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header and is used to access gated models, your spaces, and personal collections. To use OAuth login instead, connect to https://huggingface.co/mcp?login without the Authorization header.

installConfigs.instructions: Replace <HF_TOKEN> with a Hugging Face access token (https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens). The token is sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header and is used to access gated models, your spaces, and personal collections. To use OAuth login instead, change serverUrl to https://huggingface.co/mcp?login and remove the serverAuthToken.
